title: covariate_audit_rnaseq: code and summary tables for 'Sex adjustment in 2,000 public RNA-seq studies: free when balanced, costly when confounded, and rarely performed'

creators.name: Lee, Sung-Gwon
creators.affiliation: Biomedical Research Institute, Chonnam National University Hospital

creators.name: Park, Chungoo
creators.affiliation: School of Biological Sciences and Technology, Chonnam National University

description: Reanalysis pipeline (R, Python, shell) and per-study summary tables for the audit of sex adjustment in 385 human and 1,483 mouse two-group bulk RNA-seq studies from recount3: two negative-control permutations of the sex label (across all samples and within each group), an induced-imbalance experiment within balanced studies, repeated permutations with the content of the removed gene sets, GTEx sex-biased-gene enrichment, and a publication audit. Per-study differential-expression tables are deposited separately.
